name: bloodsoaked_altar_pays_tap_two_life_a_discard_and_a_sacrifice_for_a_five_five_flying_demon
notes: Printed: '{T}, Pay 2 life, Discard a card, Sacrifice a creature: Create a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying.' Two creatures (Corpse Knight, Yoked Ox) and two cards in hand (Forest, Mountain): the controller sacrifices the Ox and discards the Forest, one each; the Altar taps, life 20 -> 18; one Demon, 5/5 with flying, enters under the controller's control (Corpse Knight, 'another creature you control enters', makes the opponent lose 1).
